'''Iga no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (''iga no kuni no miyatsuko'', ''iga kokuzō'') was a {{ill|kuni no miyatsuko|ja|国造}} who ruled {{ill|Iga Province|ja|伊賀国}}.

== Overview ==
Recorded as '''Iga no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' in the "Kokuzō Hongi" of the ''{{ill|Sendai Kuji Hongi|ja|先代旧事本紀}}''.

=== Ancestry ===
*According to the "Kokuzō Hongi" of the ''Sendai Kuji Hongi'', during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Seimu|ja|成務天皇|lt=Emperor Seimu|lt_ja=成務}}, '''{{ill|Take-Igatsuwake-no-Mikoto|ja|武伊賀都別命}}''' — a third-generation descendant of {{ill|Okichiwake-no-Mikoto|ja|意知別命}}, a prince of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|ja|垂仁天皇}} — was appointed Iga no Kuni no Miyatsuko.
*Another theory traces descent from '''{{ill|Ikuhayawake-no-Mikoto|ja|息速別命}}''', another prince of the same emperor. Said to have been removed from succession because of poor health, he built a palace and lived in Iga Province. In the reign of {{ill|Emperor Ingyō|ja|允恭|lt=Emperor Ingyō|lt_ja=允恭}}, his fourth-generation descendant {{ill|Suchin-tsuto-no-Ōkimi|ja|須珍都斗王}} was granted the Abo surname.

=== Clan ===
{{ill|Abo clan|ja|阿保氏}} (''abō-uji''; {{ill|kabane|ja|姓}} of {{ill|Kimi (kabane)|ja|キミ (カバネ)|lt=Kimi}}), at one point taking the name Takebe (Takeru-be). Because Ohogashi of the reign of {{ill|Emperor Yūryaku|ja|雄略天皇|lt=Yūryaku|lt_ja=雄略}} excelled in martial arts, the surname was changed to Takebe (Takeru-be); in {{ill|Enryaku|ja|延暦}} 3 ({{ill|784|ja|784年}}), Hitokami was granted the surname Abo Ason, and his kin became Abo-no-Kimi. The {{ill|Otsuki clan|ja|小槻氏}} of {{ill|Ōmi Province|ja|近江国}} also changed surnames during the {{ill|Jōgan|ja|貞観 (日本)|lt=Jōgan}} era, but they were descended from {{ill|Ochiwake-no-Mikoto|ja|落別命}}, a half-brother of Ikuhayawake-no-Mikoto.

== Territory ==
The kuni no miyatsuko's territory was the region then known as '''Iga Province''', considered to coincide with the later {{ill|Iga Province|ja|伊賀国}}. During the reign of {{ill|Emperor Kōtoku|ja|孝徳天皇|lt=Kōtoku|lt_ja=孝徳}}, it was merged into Ise Province, but during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|ja|天武天皇|lt=Tenmu|lt_ja=天武}} it was once again separated and re-established.

=== Base ===
The kuni no miyatsuko's base was at Abo Village in {{ill|Iga District|ja|伊賀郡}}, Iga Province — corresponding to present-day {{ill|Iga, Mie|ja|伊賀市|lt=Iga City}} (former Aoyama-chō), {{ill|Mie Prefecture|ja|三重県}}.

== Tutelary deity ==
Unknown. The {{ill|shikinaisha|ja|式内社}} {{ill|Ōmura Shrine (Iga)|ja|大村神社 (伊賀市)|lt=Ōmura Shrine}} is located in Abo.

== Descendants ==
*{{ill|Abo-no-Ohogashi|ja|阿保意保賀斯}}
*:A warrior of the {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}}. Kuni no miyatsuko during the reign of Emperor Yūryaku and ancestor of the {{ill|Takebe clan|ja|建部氏}}.
*{{ill|Takebe-no-Hitokami|ja|建部人上}}
*:A {{ill|Heian-period|ja|平安時代}} official. Served as {{ill|Daigaku-no-Kami|ja|大学頭}} and {{ill|Onmyō-no-Kami|ja|陰陽頭}} during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Kanmu|ja|桓武天皇|lt=Kanmu|lt_ja=桓武}}. Returned from the Takebe surname to Abo.
